<!-- Fill in every section. Write "not run" or "none" where that is the truth. A PR without proof stays a draft. -->

## What changed

What someone can now do, or what stopped happening, and why. A sentence or two.

## Reproduced first

- [ ] I ran the app and saw the bug or the current behaviour before changing anything
- Steps:

## Proof

- [ ] It builds, and I ran the tests for what I changed (`Tools/dev/verify.py` for code)
- [ ] For a change people can see: screenshots or a recording are attached (simulator for iPhone and iPad, a window capture for the Mac)
- [ ] Gateway, runtime or speed: before and after numbers from a real run
- [ ] Bug fix: the reproduction, then the same steps passing

## Scope

- [ ] Every change serves the one thing in the title
- [ ] Text people see is plain, warm and short, with no em-dashes, codenames or TODOs
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or private chats in the change
- [ ] No attribution lines or tool footers in commits, PR text or files
- [ ] No comment explains a workaround in place of fixing the cause

## Needs a human

- [ ] Sign-in, payments, permissions or people's data
- [ ] Migration or destructive change
- [ ] Release or deploy (TestFlight, App Store, Direct, nollie.app)
- [ ] Product decision
- [ ] None of the above
